description: Escape the usual tourist tracks and come wander with us through the beating heart of Bali. We will take you deep into Ubud's emerald valleys, where the air smells of wild ginger and fresh morning dew. You will feel the cool mist of a secluded waterfall on your skin, walk the ancient stone paths of sacred water temples, and look out over rice terraces that look like giant green steps climbing to the heavens. This isn't just a sightseeing trip; it is an invitation to slow down, breathe deeply, and connect with the gentle soul of our island. Let us show you the Bali we know and love.
title: Mount Batur Jeep 4x4 Sunrise Private Tour

infoSections.title: Before You Book

content: Please bring a warm jacket or sweater, as temperatures on the mountain can drop significantly before sunrise (around 14-18 degrees Celsius).
Wear comfortable closed-toe shoes and don't forget your camera!
For a full refund, you must cancel at least 24 hours before the experience’s start time.
Tour May be cancel due to extreme weather condition with full refund
Deposit 30% is required to secure the booking. Deposit payment can be done by bank transfer, Remitly, Wise and Western union.
The rest you can pay upon arrival in Bali by cash USD or IDR . Or the remainder can be paid by online transfer no later than 7 days before arrival
Travel insurance is highly recommended for all participants .
infoSections.title: Other Think You Have To Know

importantInfo: Please wear comfortable walking shoes suitable for wet stairs. Bring a swimsuit and a change of clothes if you wish to bathe at the waterfall or participate in the holy spring ritual.

itinerary.description: Your adventure begins under a blanket of stars. Our friendly driver will meet you right at your hotel lobby in a cozy, private vehicle. As you settle in for a peaceful drive through the quiet Balinese countryside, you can catch up on some sleep before the magic starts.

pickup.description: Pick up from your hotel at 08:00

itinerary.title: Pick up from the hotel

itinerary.description: As the air grows crisp and cool, we arrive at our mountain base camp. Here, you'll meet your expert local 4x4 driver and hop into your rugged, custom-built jeep. Feel the anticipation build as we fire up the engine.
itinerary.title: Arrival at Mount Batur Base Camp
Off-Road Ascent & Sunrise Spectacle
itinerary.description: We rumble up the volcano’s slopes, navigating the bumpy, unpaved paths in the dark. Arriving at our prime viewpoint, we’ll pour you a steaming cup of Balinese coffee or tea. Watch in awe as the sun slowly peaks over the horizon, lighting up Mount Agung, the caldera lake, and the misty valleys below.

itinerary.title: Exploring the Lunar Black Lava Fields
itinerary.description: After sunrise, we drive down into the dramatic caldera to explore the vast black lava fields left by the historic 1963 eruption. The contrasts of black basalt rock against the morning sky look like another planet—perfect for incredible photos.

On our way back down, we can customize your morning. Choose to soak your muscles in the mineral-rich geothermal waters of a lakeside hot spring, or stop by a local plantation to taste freshly brewed Balinese coffee and herbal teas.
itinerary.title: Optional Coffee Plantation or Hot Spring Visit
Back to hotel
itinerary.description: With hearts full and cameras packed with spectacular memories, we tuck you back into our comfortable private car. Relax and reflect on your magical volcanic adventure as we drive you safely back to your hotel door.
